notes: The subclass deltas are applied in clientworld.c's TRACKER_PKT_S15/S16/S17 cases, including the living entities' new_pos interpolation. The tracker's negative_check_s15_for_s17 hook deliberately sends an S15 where an S17 belongs, and csrc/tests/test_clientworld.c's negative check catches it.
